title: peering: RFC 4644 CHECK/TAKETHIS responses have msgid in wrong position
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/session.rs, CHECK and TAKETHIS responses put the message-id at the END of the response text instead of right after the response code. RFC 4644 §2.3-2.4 requires: '238 <message-id> [comment]'. Current code produces '238 Send it <message-id>' instead of '238 <message-id> Send it'. Strict MODE STREAM peers use field 2 (right after code) for pipelining correlation; wrong msgid position breaks response correlation when multiple commands are in-flight. Fix: restructure format\! calls in session.rs to emit code + space + msgid first. Also affects the TAKETHIS TooLarge path: '439 Article too large {msgid}' should be '439 {msgid} Article too large'.
